# Executive AI Solutions

> Web design agency for serious local businesses. We design and hand-build custom websites, run SEO and Google Ads with real conversion tracking, and ship AI automation (site chat that answers from your own pages, automated follow-ups, adaptive pages). Every project gets a custom quote; build projects start around $2,500 USD.

## Services

- Google Ads management (https://executiveaisolutions.com/services/google-ads): campaigns built on real searches, conversion tracking, monthly cost-per-lead reporting. $500/mo plus ad spend, no minimum term.
- Custom website design and build (https://executiveaisolutions.com/services/websites): designed from your business, not a template. Tiers: Launch ($2.5k–$4.5k), Growth ($4.5k–$9k), Flagship ($9k–$18k+). Every project individually quoted.
- AI automation (https://executiveaisolutions.com/services/ai, new for 2026): ask-this-site chat answering from the client's own content, AI follow-ups, per-visitor page personalization. Quoted per project.
- Full pricing sheet: https://executiveaisolutions.com/pricing (instant estimator included; fixed quote within two days).

## Proof

- Desert Wings Flight School (https://www.desertwingsflightschool.com): custom design and build, Google Ads with wired conversion tracking, local SEO.

## Process

1. The call: 20 minutes on the business and its customers; fixed quote within two days.
2. The design: real pages in the client's brand, iterated until approved.
3. The build: hand-coded, fast, search-ready.
4. The growth: SEO, ads, and AI automation after launch.
